svg.data-weight-note: data sheet 3.2 kg; the manual says approximately 3 kg
svg.data-overall-mm: 443 x 44 x 219 (data sheet, W x H x D, with connectors)
svg.data-body-mm: 436 x 44 x 212 (manual, without brackets and without connectors)
svg.data-ntp-transactions: up to 8000 per second (NTP server without PTP/Syncjack)
svg.data-power-envelope-note: without line cards or SFPs, Vin 48 V (data sheet)
svg.data-psu-rating: 90 W AC or DC per module, two hot-swappable
svg.data-input-voltage: 100-240 VAC 47-63 Hz, or -48 to -60 VDC (tolerates -36 to -72)
svg.data-cooling: passive convection, no fans or filters
svg.data-operating-temp: AC -40 to +50 C, DC -40 to +65 C
svg.data-oscillator-aging: +/-5e-11 per day, +/-1e-11 effective after one month powered and three days locked
svg.data-gnss: GPS, GLONASS, BeiDou, Galileo; L1, 32 channels
svg.data-optics-sfp: 100/1000BaseX; SM/MM coloured or non-coloured SFP and copper SFP on every cage (data sheet); 1000BASE-SX/LX/ZX named for the network ports and 1000BASE-LX10/LH and BX10 for the access ports (manual p13)
svg.data-operation-modes: PTP grandmaster, boundary clock, slave, probe; NTP server; SSU; GNSS fan-out
svg.data-ptp-profiles: G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, enterprise, IEEE 1588 default, IEC/IEEE 61850-9-3, C37.238, SMPTE ST2059-2, AES67
svg.data-syncjack: clock and PTP probes, TE/TIE/MTIE monitoring
svg.data-local: RS-232 console on RJ-45, 10/100 management LAN on RJ-45
svg.data-protocols: CLI, SNMP v1/v2c/v3, Web GUI, Telnet, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, RADIUS, TACACS+
svg.data-emi: EN 55022 2010 Class A, EN 61000-3-2, EN 61000-3-3, EN 300 386, FCC Part 15 Class A, ICES-002 Class A
